description: This file defines the abstract class 'Database' which acts as the front-controller for Drupal's database system, managing connections, logging, and configuration.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: An un-extendable abstract class serving as the front-controller for Drupal's database system, encapsulating connection management, logging, and configuration.

methods.name: startLog
methods.description: Starts logging for a specific logging key on a given database connection.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Retrieves logged queries for a specific logging key and ends logging.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the connection object for a specified database key and target.

methods.name: isActiveConnection
methods.description: Checks if there is an active database connection.

methods.name: setActiveConnection
methods.description: Sets the active database connection key.

methods.name: parseConnectionInfo
methods.description: Processes and normalizes database connection configuration array.

methods.name: addConnectionInfo
methods.description: Adds new database connection information at runtime.

methods.name: getConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific database connection key.

methods.name: getAllConnectionInfo
methods.description: Returns all stored database connection information.

methods.name: setMultipleConnectionInfo
methods.description: Sets multiple database connections from a provided array.

methods.name: renameConnection
methods.description: Renames a database connection key and its associated info.

methods.name: removeConnection
methods.description: Removes a database connection and its info.

methods.name: openConnection
methods.description: Establishes a new connection to the database server based on stored info.

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes one or all database connections for a given key and target.

methods.name: ignoreTarget
methods.description: Temporarily ignores a specific target for a database key, falling back to default.

methods.name: convertDbUrlToConnectionInfo
methods.description: Converts a database URL into a connection info array, handling autoloading and dependencies.

methods.name: getDriverList
methods.description: Returns the list provider for available database drivers.

methods.name: getConnectionInfoAsUrl
methods.description: Returns the connection info for a database key as a URL string.

methods.name: commitAllOnShutdown
methods.description: Ensures all open connections commit transactions during shutdown.
